method: independent direct scalar traversal of static-mask DFAs; exact rational arithmetic
metric: D counts unequal endpoints over all eight original static-mask DFAs
variance_definition: population variance of D/N over all 4^k leaves
action_mean_variance_definition: population variance across four conditional means E[D/N | first paired symbol]

counterexamples.interpretation: Large total variance coexists with tied best-leaf D across every first action.
All conditional action means tie although one first action has a strictly better minimum-leaf D.

limitations: No claim is made about the globally shortest continuation for each first action.
The diagnostics show that total variance, conditional means and conditional minima measure different things; none is a confidence certificate.
